nodes.label: Verdict: engine at the bar, shell is not
nodes.rationale: The under-billing rules, rate history and adjusted-hours trace are what reviewers wish paid apps had; the gaps are around the engine: signing, updates, silent save failures, one language, no timeline, no PDF, no client/invoice, Resolve-only project names. Keep the engine sacred, rebuild the shell.

nodes.label: Sacred engine
nodes.rationale: Do not propose removing: anchors, satellites, bridge, sacred pause, rate history, adjusted-hours trace, local-only data, menu-bar-first shape.

nodes.label: Swallowed errors 37 try?
nodes.rationale: Every store write must surface failure; a billing app that loses a save silently is not premium.

nodes.label: Localization missing
nodes.rationale: 0 localized strings, 66 hard-coded UI strings, no .lproj; premium bar is a String Catalog with en + de.

nodes.label: Per-view forced dark
nodes.rationale: preferredColorScheme(.dark) in 7 views; fragile; per-view forcing is what App Review rejects.

nodes.label: Ad-hoc signing
nodes.rationale: Hardened runtime off, no entitlements; on macOS 26 the app is sent to the Trash on first launch.

nodes.label: Bundle metadata gaps
nodes.rationale: No app category, empty copyright, legacy .icns icon.

nodes.label: 1 Hz polling engine
nodes.rationale: One Timer at 1 Hz, tolerance 0.5 s, polls frontmost and idle; adequate with two cheap upgrades.

nodes.label: v1.3 Trust release
nodes.rationale: The release that makes it a real product: signing, CI, Sparkle, save failures, appearance, icon, permissions primer, shortcuts, event-driven detection, diagnostics.

nodes.label: Plan #1 Developer ID notarization hardened runtime
nodes.rationale: macOS 15 removed the right-click bypass; 26 trashes ad-hoc downloads; TCC grants stop resetting. S, $99/yr.

nodes.label: Plan #2 Tag-driven GitHub Actions release
nodes.rationale: Reproducible, no laptop in the loop. M.

nodes.label: Plan #3 Sparkle 2 updates
nodes.rationale: The only network call, disclosed in Settings and user-toggleable; brew and in-app must not fight. M.

nodes.label: Plan #4 Surface save failures
nodes.rationale: Replace 37 try? on store writes with a visible banner plus local log; cheapest credibility fix. S.

nodes.label: Plan #5 App-level appearance decision
nodes.rationale: NSApp.appearance = .darkAqua once, documented as a media-instrument exception; remove 7 per-view forces. S.

nodes.label: Plan #6 Icon Composer icon and metadata
nodes.rationale: Legacy .icns is icon jail on 26; missing metadata reads amateur. M.

nodes.label: Plan #7 Permissions primer on first run
nodes.rationale: One row per permission with reason and live status; honesty stance visible. S.

nodes.label: Plan #8 Global shortcuts and Shortcuts actions
nodes.rationale: Keyboard-first is the most-praised Mac-native trait. S.

nodes.label: Plan #9 Event-driven detection
nodes.rationale: didActivateApplicationNotification, AXObserver, keep 1 Hz idle read, stop the timer when nothing can record. M.

nodes.label: Plan #10 Local-only diagnostics
nodes.rationale: MetricKit crash/hang capture to disk plus Copy report in Settings. M.

nodes.label: Plan #11 Day timeline in Stats
nodes.rationale: 9 of 10 competitors; the fix for left-the-timer-on-during-lunch. M.

nodes.label: Plan #12 Invoice PDF from a period
nodes.rationale: CSV-only reads unfinished; 8/10 export PDF. M.

nodes.label: Plan #13 Client entity and tax mode
nodes.rationale: Legal correctness for a Swiss freelancer with EU/US/CO clients. M.

nodes.label: Plan #14 Swiss QR-bill
nodes.rationale: The premium signal for the owner's market. M.

nodes.label: Plan #15 Billing status and lock on invoice
nodes.rationale: Kills the top two invoicing complaints. S.

nodes.label: Plan #16 Rounding per project
nodes.rationale: Always down or nearest, raw seconds kept; honesty-compatible. S.

nodes.label: Plan #17 Day rate minimum units manual lines
nodes.rationale: What editors actually bill. M.

nodes.label: Plan #18 Adobe project names via Automation
nodes.rationale: Attribution for the Adobe half of the owner's day; Premiere excluded. M.

nodes.label: Plan #19 Display-sleep-assertion presence rule
nodes.rationale: Timing's rule; covers playback/review, cheaper than the CPU heuristic. S.

nodes.label: Plan #20 String Catalog and German
nodes.rationale: Owner's market; premium apps ship at least 2 languages. M.

nodes.label: Plan #21 CutawayCore package and VersionedSchema
nodes.rationale: The one structural win at this size; migration safety. M.

nodes.label: Plan #22 Desktop widget
nodes.rationale: Tyme, Timery, Hours, Rize ship one. M.

nodes.label: Not doing: Mac App Store
nodes.rationale: Sandbox breaks fuscript; helper-process rules invite rejection.

nodes.label: Not doing: iCloud sync
nodes.rationale: Contradicts local-only; Timemator's top crash complaint; paid capability.

nodes.label: Not doing: subscription pricing
nodes.rationale: Hostile reviews; one-time $39-49 with 12 months of updates and perpetual fallback is the norm; Setapp later.

nodes.label: Not doing: Screen Recording or Premiere scraping
nodes.rationale: Monthly Sequoia nag, privacy cost; Premiere stays an anchor without a project name.

nodes.label: Not doing: Stripe reminders portal retainers
nodes.rationale: Need a server or account.

nodes.label: Not doing: Pomodoro coaching or glass in content
nodes.rationale: Off-brand; Apple says glass only on the navigation layer.

nodes.label: Contradiction: Reclaim offer
nodes.rationale: Removed 2026-09-05 (spec Part 4, decision Q12-B) yet competitors report the away-time prompt sold reviewers on Timemator and Klokki; resolution: do not resurrect the card, ship the timeline; if it returns it defaults to drop with the 5-min floor and 10-h ceiling.

nodes.label: Contradiction: Notification vs card
nodes.rationale: Stays a card; apply the floor/ceiling and return-focus rule to both cards.

nodes.label: Contradiction: Forced dark
nodes.rationale: Kept, but must be one app-level decision surviving Increase Contrast x Reduce Transparency and 26.1 Clear/Tinted.

nodes.label: Contradiction: Render exemption evidence
nodes.rationale: Keep the opt-in, swap the CPU heuristic for the display-sleep assertion.

nodes.label: Launch at login kept
nodes.rationale: Confirmed right; no report suggests removing it.

nodes.label: Decisions only the owner can make
nodes.rationale: Buy the Developer Program; price and model; dark-only or light theme; Adobe Automation permission; Invoice before Timeline; German in v1.3 or later.

nodes.label: Open item: app picker shows Resolve as not installed
